text:
[RFCS.15.6] **Emission is unconditional; recording is the integrator's
cost.** The engine must emit a `CallIssued` event for every outbound call it
issues ([LFST.1.3]), and must not gate that emission on a capability, a build
flag or a configuration value.

The engine serialises nothing and grows nothing. It emits a typed event, and
the integrator encodes bytes if it wants bytes ([RFCS.15.3]). Serialization
and trace growth are therefore costs an integrator elects by subscribing, not
costs the emission imposes; an engine with no subscriber invokes nothing.

Whether a target carries a stream surface at all is a separate question and is
answered for the whole surface, never per kind ([LFST.1.3]). A `constspace`
or `realtime` build without one emits nothing and produces no trace. What no
build may do is emit some kinds and withhold others: the resulting trace reads
as complete, and nothing in it says otherwise.
